_comment: Expected staging publish manifest (offline carve), preserving saved-command inspection and current-channel discovery. Verify against InteractionRouter::publish_set with all publish gates on: TWO_AUTOMATIONS=1, TWO_ANNOUNCEMENTS=1, TWO_MODERATION=1 (plus its protected-user/role validation), TWO_COMMUNITY_SCORECARD=1. The drift test (staging_publish_manifest.rs) fails if the router-advertised set differs from this file. This fixture never touches a guild and carries no secrets: guild IDs, tokens and live publish stay in the live-publish workflow (docs/command-publish.md). Dynamic DB-backed custom commands are additive and automation-gated; the pinned 'faq' row below is a representative example so the test can prove the gating, not a claim about staging database contents.

voice._comment: Voice set published beside the 44 builtins when TWO_VOICE=1 (RouterGates::voice), in publish order after moderation, default_member_permissions as Discord decimal bitfields (null = no default gate). The voice vote-kick `kick` is the 17th voice definition but loses first-wins to moderation /kick, so it is listed under shadowed_by_first_wins instead. /templateassistant stays unpublished in every gate state until its slice lands with a handler; the `assistant` section below keeps its name and intended default gate so the slice re-activates against the same shape. The drift tests (staging_publish_manifest.rs) fail if InteractionRouter::publish_set differs; regenerate from publish_set output, never hand-edit names. Live publish read-back stays on the staging cards.
